jobs.name: 第一次圣光

body.prompt: Original instrumental orchestral film cue for witnessing a gentle miraculous healing in a modest stone room. Begin with near-silent divided strings and sparse warm harp harmonics. Slowly open into radiant but restrained high violins, rich cellos and a warm French horn answering a simple two-note rising phrase. Wonder grounded in human kindness, light appearing to help someone else. D major with suspended harmonies, 66 BPM, natural acoustic space, a clear rise followed by a soft settling release. No singing, no choir, no voices, no organ, no bells, no thunderous percussion, no action trailer sound, no electronic effects.

jobs.placement: s5 尚无场剪：st4 祈求时接近静音；st6 光柱出现才展开，st5 反应和 st7 愈合托住，st8 维里吸气开口前退下。依正式条定同步，不按分镜秒数做终混。

jobs.name: 葡萄园河岸

body.prompt: Original instrumental restrained acoustic suspense underscore for a young traveller hiding beneath a riverbank near a vineyard. Very soft low viola tremolo, occasional plucked cello notes, sparse muted horn suspensions, long spaces of almost silence. Alert listening and vulnerable curiosity, no combat, no certainty of victory. D minor and open fifths, 72 BPM, chamber orchestra, subtle changing tension instead of a repetitive loud beat. End with an unresolved suspended low string chord and a quiet natural decay. No vocals, no choir, no horror stingers, no drums, no electronic drones, no trailer rises.
